Canvas.GridSizeLockCountsHint.zh: 格数自动显示四点框内覆盖的范围，包含不完整的格子。
Canvas.GridSizeLockCountsHint.en: Counts show the coverage inside the four-point frame, including partial cells.

Canvas.GridSizeLockHelp.zh: 锁定后，调整四点保留每格代表的画布长度和原点，行列数自动变化，可含小数。勾选时画面保持原样；取消后恢复原网格规则，图层和锚点不因切换而移动。关闭透视保留锁定选择；重置或应用画布预设会解除锁定。
Canvas.GridSizeLockHelp.en: When locked, adjusting the four points preserves each cell's canvas length and the grid origin. Counts update automatically and may include fractions. Enabling the lock keeps the view unchanged; disabling it restores the original grid rules without moving layers or anchors. Turning perspective off retains the lock. Resetting or applying a canvas preset clears it.

Canvas.HelpText.zh: 拖动角点或边缘调整透视，也可用四点定位。Ctrl 暂停吸附，Shift 约束横向或竖向移动。Esc 取消，再按一次结束调整。
Canvas.HelpText.en: Drag corners or edges, or place four corners in any order. Hold Ctrl to bypass snapping or Shift to constrain movement. Esc cancels; press again to finish.

Canvas.InvalidGrid.zh: 列数和行数须为 1 至 256 的整数。
Canvas.InvalidGrid.en: Columns and rows must be integers from 1 to 256.

Canvas.InvalidQuad.zh: 四个角点须构成不交叉的凸四边形。
Canvas.InvalidQuad.en: The four corners must form a convex quadrilateral.

Canvas.UnstableProjection.zh: 透视变换过于极端，请调整四个角。
Canvas.UnstableProjection.en: The perspective is too extreme. Adjust the four corners.

Canvas.SafetyTitle.zh: 处理透视范围外的图层

Canvas.UnsafeLayers.zh: 本次调整使 {0} 个图层超出安全绘制范围（包含关联组合成员）。取消会恢复本次拖动前的状态。移回会将图层或整个组合放到四点框内或屏幕上的开阔位置，保留原始内容和尺寸；隐藏、锁定图层也会一起处理。应用与图层处理可以一次撤销。
Canvas.UnsafeLayers.en: This adjustment puts {0} layers outside the safe drawing range, including related group members. Cancel restores the state before this gesture. Move back places layers or whole groups in an open area inside the reference frame or screen, preserving content and logical size. Hidden and locked layers are included. The adjustment and layer changes can be undone together.

Canvas.RelocateFailed.zh: 无法在保持图层尺寸和组合关系的前提下找到安全位置。可以取消本次调整，或明确选择删除这些图层。
Canvas.RelocateFailed.en: No safe position was found while preserving layer size and group relationships. Cancel this adjustment or explicitly choose to delete these layers.
